## 

Code to create a dataframe with equivalent precinct ID's and names in the possible formats.

```{r}
# Load relevant shapefiles
map2024 <- st_zm(st_read("../data/maps/precincts_2024.shp"))
map2020 <- st_zm(st_read("../data/maps/precincts_2020.shp"))


precinct.name.equiv <- cbind(map2024$PRECINCT,map2024$PCT,map2024$PRC_NAME) 
  colnames(precinct.name.equiv )  <- c('PRC_ID', 'PRC_ID3','PRC_NAME_long')

temp <- st_drop_geometry(map2020) %>%
  separate(PRECINCT, into = c("ID", "PRC_NAME_short"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>% 
  cbind(map2020$PRECINCT,.)
colnames(temp) <- c('PRC_ID_NAME_short', "ID", "PRC_NAME_short")  
  

poo =  left_join(as.data.frame(precinct.name.equiv),
                 as.data.frame(temp),
                 by = c("PRC_ID" = "ID")) %>% 
  arrange(PRC_ID)

poo %>% filter(if_any(everything(),is.na))
na_row_indices <- which(apply(poo, 1, function(row) any(is.na(row))))
print(na_row_indices)
    # problems in row 229 and 251

poo[225:235,]  
poo$PRC_ID_NAME_short[229] = "3407 HARR G"
poo$PRC_NAME_short[229] = "HARR G"

poo[245:255,]  
poo$PRC_ID_NAME_short[251] = "3901 MILF A"
poo$PRC_NAME_short[251] = "MILF A"

poo %>% filter(if_any(everything(),is.na))
na_row_indices <- which(apply(poo, 1, function(row) any(is.na(row))))
print(na_row_indices)

poo$PRC_ID3_NAME_long = paste(poo$PRC_ID3,poo$PRC_NAME_long,sep=' ')

saveRDS(poo, file = "Precinct_name_id_equiv2024.rds")

```
